source.collectionVerification: The response identifies IMERG but does not disclose the collection or processing run. No version/Final/Late claim is inferred.
source.qualityNote: Date availability is temporal completeness, not retrieval quality. The documented IMERG_PRECRETRIEVALS query was rejected by the API; no counts or detailed flags are invented.
source.integration: Integrate each reported daily mm/day value over one UTC day. Monthly/annual totals are sums over complete calendars, without scaling or imputation for missing days.

site.name: Consulta piloto del Chaco seco
site.scopeWarning: Query-associated IMERG grid cell at documented nominal 0.1-degree resolution. The response echoes query coordinates; exact native cell center/bounds are not disclosed. This is not a 250-m MODIS pixel or a Gran Chaco regional average.
